author: Kairos II
title: Atlas Index Auto Rebuild + CI v1.1 (post Meta-Edge entry)
abstract: Rebuild index_auto.json by scanning entries, then run CI v1.1 to validate the new Meta-Edge entry and overall Atlas.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import build_index_auto, ci_validate
ia_path, n = build_index_auto.build()
out = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({
    "index_auto": ia_path,
    "entries_scanned": n,
    "ci_entries_found": out.get("entries_found"),
    "ci_ok": out.get("ok"),
    "ci_with_errors": out.get("with_errors"),
    "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
    "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"
}))
